question: As per HDI 2021, which of the following neighbouring countries of India had the highest female life expectancy at birth?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maldives**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• As per the Human Development Index (HDI) 2021, Maldives had the highest female life expectancy at birth among India's neighboring countries.
 
• Female life expectancy at birth in the Maldives was approximately 80.3 years in 2021.
 
• The HDI report is published by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP).
 
• Life expectancy at birth is a key component of the HDI, reflecting the overall health and longevity of a population.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Human Development Index (HDI)**

 
 
• The HDI is a composite index measuring average achievement in three basic dimensions of human development: a long and healthy life, knowledge, and a decent standard of living.
 
• The HDI is published annually by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP).
 
• Life expectancy at birth is used to measure the dimension of a long and healthy life.
 
• Education is measured by mean years of schooling and expected years of schooling.
 
• Gross National Income (GNI) per capita is used to measure the standard of living dimension.
 
 
 
• **Life Expectancy at Birth**
 
 
• Life expectancy at birth indicates the number of years a newborn infant would live if prevailing patterns of mortality at the time of birth were to stay the same throughout its life.
 
• It is a crucial indicator of the overall health and longevity of a population.
 
• Factors influencing life expectancy include healthcare quality, lifestyle, and socio-economic conditions.
 
 
 
• **Health Indicators in Maldives**
 
 
• Maldives has made significant progress in healthcare, resulting in high life expectancy rates.
 
• Key health indicators include low maternal and infant mortality rates, and high immunization coverage.
 
• The Maldives government has invested substantially in healthcare infrastructure and services.
